about: Public features of each library crate that no gated comparison compares directly with its reference, by crate: each by a short stable name, the public items it is reached through, how near it comes to a direct comparison and what a comparison would need. `degree` is one of `step` (compared only as a step inside a larger compared operation), `recorded` (checked against reference output recorded once, which no worker re-runs), `outside-gate` (compared with the reference by an opt-in test or a command the gate does not run), `unit-tests` (unit tests only), `untested` (no tests) and `no-reference` (no reference implements it). A crate listed with no features was reviewed and has none; a crate not listed is not reviewed yet. A feature leaves its list when a gated comparison compares it directly. `cargo xtask check-design` checks the list and holds the count per crate to harness/gate-exceptions.json, so a feature left uncompared is recorded as visibly as a loosened gate.

triergon-bitstream.name: bit-readers
triergon-bitstream.needs: none beyond the decoders and parsers that read through them, of which FLAC, MPEG audio and Vorbis are graded outside the gate; no reference exposes its bit reader

triergon-bitstream.name: cabac
triergon-bitstream.needs: none beyond the H.264 and HEVC decoders; no reference exposes its CABAC engine

triergon-bitstream.name: crc
triergon-bitstream.needs: each polynomial's values over a corpus against the reference's av_crc; compared only through the readers and decoders that check Ogg pages, MPEG-TS sections, Matroska elements and audio frames

triergon-bitstream.name: rbsp
triergon-bitstream.needs: none beyond the H.264, HEVC and subtitle parsers that unescape through it; no reference exposes emulation prevention removal

triergon-capture.name: session-configuration
triergon-capture.needs: capture cases with GOP, rate, VBV and mux settings other than those SessionConfig::with_rate_rule gives, against the reference sequence configured alike

triergon-codec.name: channel-layouts
triergon-codec.needs: each decoder output folded with its layout name and mask against the reference's channel layout; compared only through the channel order of the graded output

triergon-codec.name: downmix-levels
triergon-codec.needs: each frame's downmix levels folded against the reference's downmix side data; compared only through the stereo mix

triergon-codec.name: dsp-kernels
triergon-codec.needs: a worker operation running the transforms and windows on test vectors against the reference's; compared only through the AAC, AC-3, Opus and Vorbis outputs, of which Opus and Vorbis are graded outside the gate

triergon-codec-aac.name: configured-access-units
triergon-codec-aac.needs: a gate item for the access-unit decoding that the on-demand aac-access-units feature and the aac-mov lane of cargo xtask codecs grade compare; the gate grades ADTS streams only

triergon-codec-aac.name: default-build
triergon-codec-aac.needs: the aac lane and AAC workloads graded from a build without the simd feature, which is what consumers get on a stable toolchain; the gate's test step checks that build against FFmpeg float output recorded in .research/aac-references

triergon-codec-aac.name: adts-sync-search
triergon-codec-aac.needs: ADTS streams with junk and damaged headers, with the frame offsets the reference's parser finds

triergon-codec-aac.name: inspection-aids
triergon-codec-aac.needs: none: per-frame statistics of the decoder's own state behind the inspect feature, which no reference reports

triergon-codec-ac3.name: decoder-options
triergon-codec-ac3.needs: the ac3 and eac3 lanes graded with each option against the reference decoder configured alike; the gate grades the default options only

triergon-codec-ac3.name: frame-info
triergon-codec-ac3.needs: a worker operation folding each frame's header, downmix and feature fields against the reference's stream parameters and downmix side data; compared only through the decoded and mixed output

triergon-codec-ac3.name: bit-position-trace
triergon-codec-ac3.needs: none: bit positions of syntax elements for the stream tools behind the reference-trace feature, which no reference reports; the derived streams they produce are pinned

triergon-codec-dca.name: packed-input
triergon-codec-dca.needs: 14-bit and little-endian DTS streams in the dts lane, against the reference decoding the same streams; every dts vector is 16-bit big-endian

triergon-codec-flac.name: decoding
triergon-codec-flac.needs: a gate item running the flac lane of cargo xtask codecs grade; the gate's test step checks the integer output against each file's STREAMINFO MD5, and the timed file workloads require equal work, not equal output

triergon-codec-flac.name: crc-policy
triergon-codec-flac.needs: damaged FLAC files decoded with CrcPolicy::Reject, against the reference with CRC checking enabled

triergon-codec-h264.name: picture-properties
triergon-codec-h264.needs: each picture's sample aspect ratio, colour description and field flag folded against the reference's frames; the h264 lane compares planes, size and pixel format

triergon-codec-h264.name: nal-input
triergon-codec-h264.needs: a worker operation feeding NAL units one at a time, folded against the same reference pictures; compared only through Decoder::send of whole access units

triergon-codec-h264.name: stream-inspection
triergon-codec-h264.needs: a reference view of the parameter-set and slice-header features each stream uses

triergon-codec-hevc.name: picture-properties
triergon-codec-hevc.needs: each picture's sample aspect ratio and colour description folded against the reference's frames; the hevc lane compares planes, size and pixel format

triergon-codec-hevc.name: nal-input
triergon-codec-hevc.needs: a worker operation feeding NAL units one at a time, folded against the same reference pictures; compared only through Decoder::send of whole access units

triergon-codec-hevc.name: access-unit-splitting
triergon-codec-hevc.needs: Annex B streams split by AccessUnitSplitter, compared with the units of the reference's HEVC parser; the codec worker splits with its own measurement splitter

triergon-codec-hevc.name: simd-kernels
triergon-codec-hevc.needs: the codecs gate item run from a build with the simd feature; check-simd holds it to the FFmpeg digests the conformance tests record, where their inputs are present

triergon-codec-mp3.name: decoding
triergon-codec-mp3.needs: a gate item running the mp3, mp2 and mp1 lanes of cargo xtask codecs grade; the timed file workloads require equal work, not equal output

triergon-codec-mpeg1.name: encoder
triergon-codec-mpeg1.needs: a worker operation encoding YUV pictures with geometries, rates, VBV sizes and GOP lengths beyond the capture profile, against the reference's mpeg1video with the same settings; compared only inside the capture session

triergon-codec-opus.name: decoding
triergon-codec-opus.needs: a gate item running the opus lane of cargo xtask codecs grade; the timed file workloads require equal work, not equal output

triergon-codec-opus.name: final-range
triergon-codec-opus.needs: the range decoder's final state per packet against the reference decoder's for the same vectors

triergon-codec-vorbis.name: decoding
triergon-codec-vorbis.needs: a gate item running the vorbis lane of cargo xtask codecs grade; the timed file workloads require equal work, not equal output

triergon-core.name: exact-time
triergon-core.needs: a worker operation rescaling ticks across bases and rounding modes against the reference's av_rescale_rnd; compared only through the timestamps of compared readers, and with an independent Python model by the core time oracle

triergon-core.name: source-signatures
triergon-core.needs: a corpus of file prefixes with the format the reference's probe picks for each; compared only through the readers and probes built on them

triergon-core.name: reader-protocol
triergon-core.needs: every compared reader fed windows of every size and resumed after each Yield and Backpressure, folded against the same reference output; compared only as the protocol the compared readers run on

triergon-core.name: budgets
triergon-core.needs: none: storage and work accounting that no reference has; the memory gates measure its effect

triergon-elementary.name: packet-reading
triergon-elementary.needs: a gate item running the reader-flac, reader-mp3, reader-aac, reader-ac3 and reader-eac3 lanes of cargo xtask codecs readers; the gate runs the Ogg lanes only

triergon-elementary.name: seeking
triergon-elementary.needs: seek cases for FLAC, MPEG audio, ADTS and AC-3 files through codec-worker seek, against ffprobe -read_intervals

triergon-elementary.name: stream-metadata
triergon-elementary.needs: a reference view of each stream's properties, tags and FLAC metadata blocks (ffprobe -show_streams -show_format), folded per file

triergon-elementary.name: format-probe
triergon-elementary.needs: a corpus of files with the format the reference's probe picks for each; compared only inside the file workloads, which require equal work, not equal output

triergon-font.name: store
triergon-font.needs: a worker operation whose output depends on what the store keeps under its budget; no reference exposes an equivalent cache

triergon-framing.name: nal-length-prefixed-reading
triergon-framing.needs: a worker operation reading length-prefixed NAL units from MP4 and Matroska samples, folded against the reference's units; only Annex B reading is compared (raw-annex-b, mpegts-access-units)

triergon-framing.name: nal-configuration-inputs
triergon-framing.needs: a corpus of Annex B and declared parameter sets with a reference projection of the configuration each gives and of its Annex B form

triergon-framing.name: hevc-hvcc-prefix-inspection
triergon-framing.needs: a corpus of whole and truncated hvcC records with a reference view of the fields the prefix inspection reports

triergon-framing.name: hevc-record-writing
triergon-framing.needs: a worker operation writing hvcC records and their Annex B form, compared byte for byte with the reference's conversion of the same samples

triergon-framing.name: av1-obu-reading
triergon-framing.needs: a worker operation reading OBUs incrementally, folded against the reference's OBUs of the same temporal units

triergon-framing.name: vp9-configuration
triergon-framing.needs: a VP9 corpus with a reference view of the configuration the parser reads

triergon-framing.name: aac-configuration-views
triergon-framing.needs: a reference view of AudioSpecificConfig at both extents and of the decoder configuration and channel views it gives

triergon-framing.name: aac-adts-buffer-parsing
triergon-framing.needs: a worker operation parsing ADTS frames from complete buffers, compared with the reference's frames and headers

triergon-framing.name: eac3-bsi
triergon-framing.needs: an E-AC-3 corpus with a reference view of every bitstream information field

triergon-framing.name: dts-core-inspection
triergon-framing.needs: a feature contract and worker operation for what the opt-in dts_packet_corpus test compares with the pinned FFmpeg outside the gate

triergon-framing.name: dts-core-extent
triergon-framing.needs: a reference of each core frame's declared extent over the DTS corpus

triergon-framing.name: dts-packings
triergon-framing.needs: 14-bit and packed DTS inputs with a reference of the normal frames they carry

triergon-framing.name: dts-reference-trace
triergon-framing.needs: a worker operation that runs this comparison projection against the reference

triergon-isobmff.name: segment-indexes
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation reading sidx, tfra and mfro boxes, compared with the reference's segment and fragment index entries

triergon-isobmff.name: quicktime-pcm-sound
triergon-isobmff.needs: a corpus of version 0 QuickTime sound descriptions with a reference view of their fields and PCM samples

triergon-isobmff.name: mov-pcm-packets
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation grouping QuickTime PCM samples into packets, folded against the reference's packets; tests check recorded reference output in tests/fixtures/pcm-v0

triergon-isobmff.name: mov-run-recovery
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker profile running run and direct recovery and physical reads against the reference's recovered packets; --recover-regular-tables runs description recovery only

triergon-isobmff.name: mov-track-seek
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation seeking one track on its own against the reference; compared only as the per-track step of GlobalSeekJob (isobmff-seek)

triergon-isobmff.name: source-seek-planning
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation planning seeks to a sample ordinal with a caller's preroll and looking up composition times, against the reference; compared only inside MovieSourceSeekPlanner range plans (isobmff-seek)

triergon-isobmff.name: dts-core-signalling
triergon-isobmff.needs: a corpus of DTS sample entries with the reference's verdict on their core signalling

triergon-isobmff.name: mov-encoded-views
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation projecting the metadata, recovery and dependency views of encoded entries against the reference; tests check recorded reference output in tests/fixtures

triergon-isobmff.name: mov-reference-trace
triergon-isobmff.needs: a worker operation that runs these comparison projections against the reference; tests check recorded reference output only

triergon-matroska.name: block-addition-side-data
triergon-matroska.needs: a worker operation folding each packet's HDR10+, LCEVC and opaque block additions against the reference's packet side data; matroska-colour compares static HDR metadata only

triergon-matroska.name: track-extensions
triergon-matroska.needs: a corpus with BlockAdditionMapping elements and the reference's stream side data for them

triergon-matroska.name: codec-state
triergon-matroska.needs: a corpus with CodecState elements and a reference view of the configuration each block is decoded with

triergon-matroska.name: typed-attachments
triergon-matroska.needs: the catalogue fold read through the typed attachment view instead of the element tree, against the reference's attachment streams

triergon-matroska.name: metadata-view-fields
triergon-matroska.needs: the catalogue fold extended with these typed fields, against the reference's chapters, tags and format metadata

triergon-ogg.name: push-reader-windows
triergon-ogg.needs: a worker operation feeding Reader windows of varied sizes down to one byte under a small budget, folded against the same reference packets; compared only through BlockingReader

triergon-ogg.name: track-properties
triergon-ogg.needs: a reference view of each track's channels, comment header, configuration bytes and duration (ffprobe -show_streams), folded per track; the reader comparison folds codec, tag, link, serial and time base only

triergon-ogg.name: page-codec
triergon-ogg.needs: pages parsed and written compared with the reference's Ogg demuxer and muxer for the same packets

triergon-ogg.name: sequential-source
triergon-ogg.needs: the reader-ogg lane read through open_stream from a source without Seek, against the same reference packets

triergon-pixel.name: ycbcr-palette
triergon-pixel.needs: palette entries converted against the reference's subtitle palette conversion; compared only through the DVB, PGS and DVD subtitle decoders' output

triergon-session.name: track-decoding
triergon-session.needs: a gate item grading the lanes that decode through TrackDecoder (flac, mp3, mp2, mp1, vorbis, opus, aac-mov) and aac-access-units; the timed file workloads require equal work, not equal output

triergon-session.name: audio-session
triergon-session.needs: a worker operation feeding demuxed packets through AudioSession and folding its PCM blocks and times against the reference's decoded frames; cargo xtask session-queues compares two revisions only

triergon-session.name: video-session
triergon-session.needs: a worker operation feeding demuxed packets through VideoSession and folding its published pictures and times against the reference's decoded frames; cargo xtask session-queues compares two revisions only

triergon-shape.name: libass-rotations
triergon-shape.needs: shape-libass cases on @ faces against libass's font functions, which shape-libass excludes; compared only through ass-render's vertical fixtures

triergon-subtitles.name: text-extraction
triergon-subtitles.needs: a worker operation extracting WebVTT in Matroska, tx3g, UTF-8 and ASS samples, folded against the packets and WebVTT side data the reference's demuxers return; only triergon-bridge's tests drive it

triergon-subtitles.name: charset-conversion
triergon-subtitles.needs: a worker operation converting whole byte streams with every Charset and MultibyteCharset profile against the reference's iconv; compared only as the conversion inside compat::ass::Decoder for labelled packets

triergon-subtitles.name: compat-charset-packets
triergon-subtitles.needs: a worker operation converting labelled ASS packets through AssPacketJob against the reference's sub_charenc; subtitle-text compares that conversion through compat::ass::Decoder only

triergon-subtitles.name: tx3g-configuration
triergon-subtitles.needs: a corpus of tx3g sample descriptions with a reference view of their default style, text box, fonts and boxes

triergon-subtitles.name: tx3g-semantics
triergon-subtitles.needs: a reference that resolves 3GPP TS 26.245 styles, highlights, karaoke and links per character; none of the pinned references exposes one

triergon-subtitles.name: renderer-context
triergon-subtitles.needs: a worker operation building contexts from Matroska track headers, tags and attachments, compared with the header and fonts the reference hands libass

triergon-subtitles.name: dvb-source-boundary
triergon-subtitles.needs: a worker operation building DVB configurations from TS subtitling descriptors and Matroska CodecPrivate, and packets with their source clocks, against the reference's extradata and packet times; only triergon-bridge's tests drive it

triergon-subtitles.name: pgs-segments
triergon-subtitles.needs: a worker operation folding each segment's parsed fields against a reference view of them; compared only as the parse inside compat::pgs::ReceiverDecoder

triergon-subtitles.name: vobsub-index-lines
triergon-subtitles.needs: a corpus of .idx files with a reference view of each line; compared only as the parse inside compat::dvd::VobSubIndex

triergon-subtitles.name: dvd-ifo-palette
triergon-subtitles.needs: DVD subpictures decoded with the palette ifo_palette reads, against the reference's dvdsub decoder given the same IFO file

triergon-subtitles.name: carriage-reference-trace
triergon-subtitles.needs: a worker operation that runs this comparison projection against the reference; tests compare it with recorded reference output
